entries.zh: 学号和密码保存在操作系统的受保护凭据存储中。保存有效凭据且开启自动学期检测后，启动时会自动刷新一次个人课表，用于校验学期号和第一周周一。你主动请求课表、空教室或作业时也会按对应用途通过 HTTPS 使用凭据。课表和空教室请求发送到 jwglweixin.bupt.edu.cn；平台允许时还可能自动刷新当天空教室。维护者无法读取凭据，设置接口也不会返回密码。
entries.en: Credentials stay in protected OS storage. With valid saved credentials and automatic term detection enabled, the app refreshes the personal schedule once at launch to verify the term identifier and first Monday. Credentials are also used over HTTPS for schedules, classrooms, or assignments you request. Schedule and classroom requests go to jwglweixin.bupt.edu.cn; supported platforms may refresh today’s classrooms automatically. The maintainer cannot read credentials, and settings APIs never return a password.

entries.zh: 课表、空教室、校区、学期、开关、自定义日程地址和最多 500 条收藏快照保存在设备上；课程小组件只读取本地课表。课程删除记录按账号和学期隔离，仅影响本机有效课表，可在设置中恢复。“清除本地数据”会一并移除这些内容。
entries.en: Schedules, classroom results, campus, term, switches, the custom feed URL, and up to 500 favorite snapshots stay locally. Course widgets read only the local schedule. Course deletions are isolated by account and term, affect only the effective timetable on this device, and can be restored in Settings. Clear local data removes all of these items.

entries.zh: 应用可能通过 unpkg 获取固定版本 holiday-calendar 数据；Android 在已有权限时也可能读取系统节假日日历。请求仅含 CN 与年份。iOS 只依据权威休息日数据显示“休”。
entries.en: The app may retrieve pinned holiday-calendar data through unpkg; Android may read the OS holiday calendar when permitted. Requests contain only CN and year. iOS marks rest days only from authoritative rest-day data.

entries.zh: UAPI 按校区行政区提供天气与基础黄历，不读取 GPS；Timeless 可补充宜忌。公开活动优先读取 GitHub 上的 Contest DDL，where-to-study.cn 镜像仅在数据更新时间较新时使用，两者不可用时改用原有备用 API；校内竞赛通知另有来源。这些公开请求均不附带个人凭据。自定义日程只向用户填写的 HTTPS 地址发送无凭据 GET，拒绝重定向、本机和私有/保留 IP 字面量，响应上限 2 MiB。所有显示数据仅供参考。
entries.en: UAPI provides district-level weather and base almanac data without GPS. Timeless may add advice. Public events use Contest DDL on GitHub first; the where-to-study.cn mirror is selected only when its generated data is newer, and the existing API is a fallback if both fail. Campus contest notices have a separate source. These public requests carry no personal credentials. Custom schedules use credential-free GET requests only to the user-provided HTTPS URL, reject redirects, localhost, and literal private/reserved IPs, and limit responses to 2 MiB. Displayed data is for reference only.

entries.zh: 密码仅通过 HTTPS 提交给 auth.bupt.edu.cn，一次性票据换取内存令牌后从 apiucloud.bupt.edu.cn 读取作业。可单独设置教学云平台密码，并保存在同一受保护凭据存储中；未设置时使用教务密码。应用不读取浏览器 Cookie，不向 UCloud API 发送密码，也不把票据、Cookie、令牌或作业写入磁盘；结果最多在内存复用 10 分钟。
entries.en: The password is submitted only to auth.bupt.edu.cn over HTTPS. An optional separate Teaching Cloud Platform password uses the same protected credential storage; otherwise the academic password is used. An in-memory token is used with apiucloud.bupt.edu.cn. No browser cookie, ticket, token, or assignment is persisted, and results are reused in memory for at most ten minutes.

entries.zh: QMplus 与北邮教务账号独立。只有用户主动连接时，应用才在独立的应用内 WebView 进程和 profile 打开 QMplus 官方网页，由用户直接完成 SSO／Microsoft MFA；应用没有 Microsoft 密码输入框，也不读取外部浏览器 Cookie。只读脚本返回有界的课程与 Assignment／Quiz 业务快照，不返回密码、Cookie、sesskey、令牌或完整 HTML，不提交作业、开始测验或经过第三方 Worker／本项目服务器。业务快照保存在应用私有存储中；真正部分失败时保留并标注此前已知资料。断开连接或清除本地数据会清除应用管理的网页会话与快照；更换北邮账号不会自动更换 QMplus 身份。官方 QMplus／Microsoft 可按自身政策处理登录信息及网络元数据。
entries.en: QMplus is independent of BUPT academic credentials. Only when you connect does the app open the official QMplus page in a separate app-owned WebView process/profile, where you complete SSO/Microsoft MFA directly. The app has no Microsoft password field and reads no external-browser cookies. Its read-only script returns a bounded course and Assignment/Quiz business snapshot, not passwords, cookies, session keys, tokens, or full HTML; it never submits work, starts quizzes, or uses a third-party Worker or this project’s server. The snapshot is stored in app-private storage; genuine partial failures retain labelled known information. Disconnecting or clearing local data removes the app-managed web session and snapshot; changing BUPT credentials does not switch the QMplus identity. Official QMplus/Microsoft services may process sign-in information and network metadata under their own policies.

entries.zh: QMplus 独立连接 / Independent QMplus connection
日历写入和本地课程通知需要你的操作与权限；应用只管理带 Where To Study 标记的事件。课程小组件只在支持的平台提供，相关数据不上传。
entries.en: Calendar writes and local course notifications require your action and permission, and only marked events are managed. Widgets exist only on supported platforms. This data is not uploaded.

entries.zh: 本项目只运营用于整理公开班车与活动数据的固定接口，不提供用户账户、云端同步、广告、分析或行为跟踪服务，也不收集 GPS 位置、联系人、广告标识符、诊断或使用行为。北邮服务、unpkg、UAPI、Timeless、GitHub Pages、Where To Study 固定公开接口和用户选择的自定义日程服务器可能依据各自政策处理 IP 地址、请求时间等普通网络元数据。
entries.en: The project operates only fixed endpoints that organize public shuttle and event data. It provides no user accounts, cloud synchronization, advertising, analytics, or behavioral tracking and does not collect GPS location, contacts, advertising identifiers, diagnostics, or usage behavior. BUPT services, unpkg, UAPI, Timeless, GitHub Pages, the fixed public Where To Study endpoints, and a user-selected custom schedule server may process ordinary network metadata such as IP address and request time under their own policies.

entries.zh: 凭据与缓存保留在设备上，直到被替换、清除或随卸载移除；清除本地数据不会删除学校或第三方持有的记录。
entries.en: Credentials and caches stay on your device until replaced, cleared, or removed with the app. Clearing local data does not delete third-party records.

entries.zh: 隐私政策与个人信息保护
欢迎使用 Where To Study。请在继续前阅读并理解隐私政策。应用会在你保存账号或请求课表、空教室、作业时，通过 HTTPS 向北京邮电大学相关服务提交必要信息；保存有效账号后，还可能按已启用的设置自动刷新课表与当天空教室。课表、账号与偏好保存在本机。点击“同意并继续”表示你已阅读并同意隐私政策；拒绝后将退出应用且无法使用主功能。
entries.en: Welcome to Where To Study. Please read and understand the Privacy Policy before continuing. When you save an account or request schedules, classrooms, or assignments, the app sends necessary information over HTTPS to relevant BUPT services. After valid credentials are saved, enabled settings may also refresh the schedule and today’s empty classrooms automatically. Schedules, credentials, and preferences stay on this device. By tapping “Agree and Continue,” you confirm that you have read and agree to the Privacy Policy. If you decline, the app exits and its main features remain unavailable.

entries.en: Set 1–5 different reminder times, each 1–1440 minutes before class. Retry if saving fails.

entries.zh: 无法启用课前提醒，请检查通知权限后重试。
entries.en: Could not enable reminders. Check notification permission and try again.

entries.zh: 课前提醒 · 提前 %1$d 分钟
使用本地课表，按北京时间提醒未来课程与已确定时间的考试，默认提前 10 分钟。已获得准时提醒权限；关闭设备或系统限制仍可能影响送达。每日摘要独立设置。设置仅保存在本机，不上传。
entries.en: Uses your local timetable for future classes and timed exams in Beijing time, 10 minutes before by default. Precise reminder access is granted; powering off or system restrictions may still affect delivery. Daily summaries are separate. Settings stay on this device and are not uploaded.

entries.zh: 使用本地课表，按北京时间提醒未来课程与已确定时间的考试，默认提前 10 分钟。目前为大致时间提醒，系统节电可能延迟或错过通知；不会补发已过时的提醒。每日摘要独立设置。设置仅保存在本机，不上传。
entries.en: Uses your local timetable for future classes and timed exams in Beijing time, 10 minutes before by default. Delivery is approximate: battery saving may delay or miss reminders. Expired reminders are not replayed. Daily summaries are separate. Settings stay on this device and are not uploaded.

entries.zh: 无法打开准时提醒权限设置，将继续使用大致时间提醒。
entries.en: Could not open precise reminder settings. Approximate delivery remains available.

entries.zh: 小组件优先显示今日课程，剩余空间补充标有“明日”的课程，总数受课程上限限制。预览使用虚构示例，不会写入课表。
entries.en: Today’s courses appear first; spare space shows courses marked “Tomorrow”, within the course limit. This preview uses fictional data and does not change your schedule.

entries.zh: 在桌面查看今天的课程、节次、教室、教师与上课状态。
entries.en: View today’s courses, periods, rooms, instructors, and status on your home screen.

entries.zh: 今日课程小组件样式预览，%1$s，共 %2$d 门示例课程
entries.en: Today’s Courses widget preview, %1$s, with %2$d sample courses

entries.zh: 教学云平台 · 当前课程
教学云平台当前暂无课程
entries.en: No current Teaching Cloud Platform courses

entries.zh: 刷新当前课程；复用教学云平台会话，不提前获取所有课程作业。
entries.en: Refresh current courses using the existing Teaching Cloud Platform session, without fetching every assignment.

entries.zh: 退出 QMplus 并清除会话
entries.en: Sign Out and Clear QMplus Session

entries.zh: 正在只读同步课程与已发布的作业 / 测验…
entries.en: Syncing courses and published assignments / quizzes read-only…

entries.zh: 已保存 QMplus 课程快照；刷新需在官方页面完成。
entries.en: QMplus course snapshot saved; refresh through the official page.

entries.zh: 尚未连接 QMplus，请在设置中完成官方 SSO / MFA 登录后同步课程。
entries.en: QMplus not connected. Complete official SSO / MFA in Settings, then sync courses.

entries.zh: 在官方网页完成 SSO / MFA，不新增 Microsoft 密码字段，也不读取外部浏览器 Cookie。业务缓存仅保存课程与作业 / 测验时间，不含密码、会话 Cookie 或 sesskey。退出会清除本应用的 QMplus 网页会话与课程缓存。
entries.en: Complete SSO / MFA on the official page. No Microsoft password field is added and external browser cookies are not read. The business cache contains courses and assignment / quiz times, not passwords, session cookies or sesskey. Signing out clears this app’s QMplus web session and course cache.

entries.zh: 在官方页面完成 SSO / MFA 后点击“同步课程”。仅同步课程及已发布的作业 / 测验，不会提交作业或开始测验。
entries.en: Complete official SSO / MFA, then select “Sync Courses”. Only courses and published assignments / quizzes are read; nothing is submitted and no quiz attempt is started.

entries.zh: QMplus 同步未完成。请检查官方登录状态与网络后重试；原课程缓存不受影响。
entries.en: QMplus sync did not complete. Check the official login and network, then retry. The previous course cache is unaffected.

entries.zh: 此设备无法打开官方 QMplus 登录网页。请检查系统 WebView 是否可用后重试；原课程缓存不受影响。
entries.en: This device cannot open the official QMplus login page. Check that System WebView is available, then retry. The previous course cache is unaffected.

entries.zh: 无法清除 QMplus 课程缓存，请重试。
entries.en: Unable to clear the QMplus course cache. Please retry.

entries.zh: 正在清除本应用的 QMplus 网页会话…
entries.en: Clearing this app’s QMplus web session…

entries.zh: 本地业务数据已清除，QMplus 网页会话正在异步清除；完成前不能再次连接。
entries.en: Local business data cleared. The QMplus web session is clearing asynchronously; reconnect is disabled until it completes.

entries.zh: 本次同步不完整，保留先前已知活动；未读到的活动不代表已完成或已删除。
entries.en: This sync is incomplete; previously known activities are retained. Missing activities are not assumed completed or deleted.

entries.zh: 暂无当前学期 EBU 课程。
尚未获取课程作业；可在作业查询中主动刷新。
entries.en: Assignments not fetched yet. Refresh them explicitly in the assignments view.

entries.zh: 当前缓存没有关联到这门课程的作业。
entries.en: No cached assignments linked to this course.

entries.zh: 当前快照没有这门课程的作业或测验。
entries.en: No assignments or quizzes for this course in the current snapshot.

entries.zh: 其他 / 学期未确认课程（%1$d） ⌄
收起其他 / 学期未确认课程（%1$d） ⌃
学期未确认，不自动归为当前学期
entries.en: Term unconfirmed; not automatically treated as current

entries.zh: Quiz · 测验（开放区间不是固定考试时段）
entries.en: Quiz (availability is not a fixed exam time)

entries.zh: 详情受限或未完整读取；未确认的时间不作推断。
entries.en: Detail restricted or incomplete; unconfirmed times are not inferred.
